special_traits.name: Amphibious
special_traits.description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

special_traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
special_traits.description:
If
the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It
can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Acid Arrow (level 3 version).

actions.name: Rend
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6
+ 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

actions.name: DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-footwide Line
actions.description: Failure: 54 (12d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

legendary_actions.name: creature the dragon can see within 120 feet
legendary_actions.description: Failure: 22 (4d10) Poison damage, and the target has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Frightful Presence
legendary_actions.description:
The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Fear. The dragon can't take this action again until the
start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.description:
The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it
makes one Rend attack.
